description: This file defines administrative API routes for managing templates and viewing audit logs in a FastAPI application.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define routes under '/api/v1/admin'.

methods.name: List[TemplateOut] admin_list_templates(_: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all plan templates for admin users.

methods.name: TemplateOut admin_create_template( payload: TemplateCreate, _: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new plan template by admin users.

methods.name: List[AuditLogRead] admin_list_audit_logs(_: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve audit logs, limited to the most recent 500 entries.

ctags.name: admin_create_template
ctags.signature: ( payload: TemplateCreate, _: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: admin_list_audit_logs
ctags.pattern: /^def admin_list_audit_logs(_: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> /

ctags.pattern: /^def admin_list_templates(_: object = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> L/
